description: Files that name three or more catalog cities in string literals. A pending entry is a hand-maintained list still to migrate onto contracts/catalogs/markets.json; a fixture entry is synthetic or demo data where a city is an attribute, not the list of served cities. Counts may only shrink: run node tool/contracts/generate_market_catalog.mjs --prune after a migration. Never add an entry for a new product city list; read the catalog or a generated copy instead.

admin/src/features/marketplace/api/marke.reason: Sample marketplace metrics for the admin preview data source.

admin/src/features/marketplace/ui/Market.reason: City label map for the marketplace view; PR 2 reads labels from the generated catalog.

admin/src/features/sales/api/salesReposi.reason: Sample organizer rows for the admin preview data source.

functions/src/demoOps/generated/suvbotDe.reason: Generated demo worlds; synthetic organizers per city.

operations/src/workflows/supply-intake/c.reason: Supply-intake search matrix city slugs; PR 2 validates them against the catalog.
Supply-intake crawl targets name catalog cities; PR 2 validates or derives them from the catalog.

tool/demo/demo_ops_core.mjs.reason: Demo operations scenarios keyed by city; resolves markets through location_markets.mjs.

tool/demo/demo_seed/personas/india_core_.reason: Synthetic demo personas; city is a persona attribute, not the served-city list.

tool/demo/rsvp_escape/form_definition.mj.reason: Synthetic RSVP form options for a demo fixture.

tool/demo/seed_demo_data.mjs.reason: Demo seed scenarios keyed by city (neighbourhoods, languages); resolves markets through location_markets.mjs.

website/src/content/markets/in.ts.reason: Website market pack with its own ids and statuses; PR 3 of the market catalog work generates it from the catalog.
